description: Why a name is not a buy today, in plain words: the market gate, a chase, a falling trend, a report coming up or no entry window. The plain reason one stock or ETF is not a candidate today, or the state that makes it one: the market gate for the name's own book and sector, its entry window (READY, SETUP, WAIT, CHASE, FALLING or BASING) and earnings inside five trading days. Not buying is the lesson. Free: one symbol per call, states only and no scores, one market day delayed.
name: why_not
